handoff_instructions: Fixed review_notes on M2-T04. File: supabase/migrations/0004_leads.sql. All four composite FKs that previously used bare 'on delete set null' (leads_customer_same_org_fkey, leads_employee_same_org_fkey, leads_communication_same_org_fkey, lead_activities_communication_same_org_fkey) now use the PG15+ column-list form 'on delete set null (<fk_column>)', matching the existing precedent in supabase/migrations/0002_m1_foundation.sql:83 (jobs_customer_same_org_fkey). This scopes the SET NULL action to only the nullable FK column itself, so organization_id (NOT NULL) is never nulled on delete of a referenced customer/employee/communication — resolves the reviewer's correctness concern without weakening RLS/tenant isolation or making organization_id nullable. No other files touched. pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm test all pass (test suite applies every migration, incl. 0004, via the PGlite harness in packages/core/test/helpers/db.ts). Next: ready for ChatGPT re-review.
review_notes: ChatGPT requested changes: Critical: The composite foreign keys that include organization_id use ON DELETE SET NULL (leads -> customers/employees/communications and lead_activities -> communications). In Postgres, SET NULL applies to all referencing columns in the FK, which will attempt to set organization_id to NULL; this violates the NOT NULL constraint on organization_id and will fail in production PG even if the PGlite harness passes. Please change these to a safe action (e.g., ON DELETE RESTRICT/NO ACTION), or otherwise adjust the design so organization_id is not nulled (do not make organization_id nullable). Update all affected FKs accordingly and re-run the harness. Everything else (RLS, audit trigger, indexes) looks good.
